name: browser-use
headline: claude marketplace for Focus.AI
short_description: Claude Code plugin marketplace offering 15+ integrations for media generation, browser automation, Google services, social media, productivity tools, accounting, infrastructure, and research.
author: The-Focus-AI

sections.overview:
The focus-marketplace is a Claude Code plugin registry that centralizes integrations for Focus.AI development and third-party services. It includes plugins for media generation (image and video via Google Gemini), browser automation through Chrome DevTools, Google services (Gmail, Sheets, Docs, YouTube), Twitter/X posting, newsletter management, meeting transcripts, QuickBooks accounting, Hetzner server deployment, Polymarket analytics, and semantic document search. Users install the marketplace once, then selectively add individual plugins like nano-banana for AI media, chrome-driver for web automation, or marina-skill for infrastructure management. Each plugin operates as a standalone module with dedicated commands and skills, enabling developers and teams to automate workflows across communication, content creation, productivity, and deployment without switching tools.
Generate AI images and videos from text prompts using nano-banana plugin
Automate web scraping, PDF generation, and form filling with chrome-driver
Send emails, manage calendars, and create spreadsheets via Google services
Post to Twitter and manage social media timelines with twitter-skill
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/The-Focus-AI/claude-marketplace`
